I'm an analyst at New Zealand's Treasury in Wellington. An economist by training, I spend much of my time writing code (or, increasingly, reviewing the AIs'), puzzling over data, and trying to make trade-offs in public policy a little clearer.

I write about economics, books, and the coolest things I learn each year. There is more [about me](about.qmd), and I circulate an old-school [links blast](weekend-reads.qmd) on weekends.
